Commands_Blurb: Everything the server can be told to do. Each one runs exactly what you would type on the console, so the result appears there.
Commands_Kick: Disconnect a player and keep them out for a while.
Commands_Mute: Stop a player speaking for a while.
Commands_Ban: Ban a player's account for good.
Commands_RefreshBanList: Reload the ban list from disk.
Commands_Motd: Set the message of the day.
Commands_Respawn: Reset one map's items and NPCs.
Commands_MapReport: List the map numbers nobody has authored yet.
Commands_AdvanceWar: Push war night into its next phase.
Console_StoppingNotice: Asked the server to shut down. It saves everything still in memory before it exits, so give it up to {Seconds} seconds.
Console_ConnectionLost: The connection to the server ended.
Console_ShutdownBlocked: Not sent. This window cannot start a remote server back up, so use that server's own console if it has to go down.
Config_WindowGroupHint: Applies as soon as you change it.
Config_ServerGroupHint: Saved together, and applied the next time the server starts.
Connection_Blurb: Which server this window drives. This setting belongs to this window, not to any server.
Connection_LocalHint: Run the server beside this shell as a child process. Start and Stop control it directly.
Connection_RemoteHint: Attach to a server that is already running elsewhere. It has to have remote management turned on, and it keeps running when you detach.
Connection_TokenHint: The token that server was given. Kept in this window's own settings file so you are not retyping it.
Config_DeathPenaltyBlurb: What a player loses when they die. Each part is independent, and players under level 10 are spared either way.
Config_DurabilityLossHint: Worn equipment loses durability, and a caster loses reagents to match. Rain doubles it; a guild war doubles it again.
Config_ItemDropHint: Part of the bag falls on the ground. A player flagged for PK drops all of it, plus a chance at each worn piece.
Config_ExpLossHint: Death costs experience, and enough of it costs levels. Turning this off also means a PvP kill pays nothing, since that reward is taken from the victim.
Config_LanguageBlurb: The language this window, the server console and the log files use. Players are not affected: each one sees the game in the language they chose.
Config_LanguageServerNote: This window changes straight away. The server console follows the next time it starts.
Logging_Blurb: What the server writes down, and how long it keeps it. Logs go to the logs folder beside the server.
Logging_LevelHint: How much the server records. Debug is everything; Warning and Error keep only what went wrong.
Logging_PacketsHint: Off by default, and worth leaving off: a busy server writes an enormous amount here. Turn them on to diagnose a connection problem. They have their own log file and never crowd the main one.
Logging_RetentionHint: Days. A new file is started each day; older ones are deleted past this count.
Logging_Unavailable: Some of these are not where they are expected in appsettings.json, so they are shown greyed out rather than overwritten. Restore the file's shape to edit them here.
Management_Blurb: Lets this server's console be reached from another machine, so you can watch it and run commands without being at the box.
Management_EnableHint: Both a port and a token are needed. Traffic is encrypted, and the token is the only thing standing between the port and your server's console, so treat it like a password.
Management_TokenHint: Give this to whoever attaches. Generate makes a fresh one; anyone still using the old token is cut off.
Management_LocalOnly: These settings belong to the server installed here. Attach locally to change them.
Config_RestartRequired: Changes apply the next time the server starts.
